# Local KaTeX distribution

Version: 0.19.0. Source: official npm package `https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz`.

Only the minified browser JavaScript, stylesheet, required fonts and MIT license are vendored. No npm dependencies are needed to open the documentation.

Browser setup: https://katex.org/docs/browser
API: https://katex.org/docs/api

The `fonts/` directory must stay beside `katex.min.css`. Do not edit generated vendor files; update them from a pinned official release.
